## Objective

Bring each installation into conformance with the selected sources and verify the current project-specific authority bindings.

## Scope

- The mapped Template, active depot instructions, role catalogs, affected binding references and existing integrity tests.

## Entry conditions

- The exact reusable source files and any justified edits have been reviewed. The initial state of each active destination is known.

## Exit criteria

- The updater reports current, every selected Template file matches its source, and the depot retains its local instructions and policy.
- Current bindings match the governing files. Targeted and broader results distinguish issues caused by the change from unrelated baseline findings.

## Risks

- A bulk update can capture unrelated work or overwrite a depot-specific file. Inspect the update's proposed paths and adopt into each local file against its own baseline.

### Risks

- The updater evaluates more than the selected files. If the preview includes unrelated work, preserve it and report the owner conflict. Review any generated role-index delta.

### Acceptance criteria

- The installed updater's check exits 0 and reports current. Each selected Template file has the same bytes as its reusable source.
- The Template's own instructions load its soul and paired roles, and its role catalog is valid with a current index.

### Planned verification

- From the depot run .venv/bin/python -B tools/template_update.py check. Resolve only attributable pending paths through the existing update route and repeat the check after distribution.
- Compare SHA-256 values at every selected source and Template destination, then run the Template copy of role_catalog.py with --repo-root Projects/Sys4AI-Template-Project validate --format json.

- The reusable Director, general worker and communication files have legitimate differences from the active depot copies. Wholesale replacement would discard local behavior.

- The active soul has the rule in the approved position and the entry points load it. The Director, communication skill, general worker and three specialist pairs meet their corresponding requirements.

- Diff against the working baseline, read the applicable clauses of AGENTS.md and ROLE.md, and run the active role_catalog.py with --repo-root . validate --format json.

### Risks

- A historical pin may differ from an active owner binding. Preserve historical receipts and classify any broader-suite failure using current evidence.

### Acceptance criteria

- Each current binding covers the exact governing files and any affected current source reference resolves. Historical evidence and authority scope are preserved.
- The completion-specific root test and Template contract suite pass. Broader root results name any failures, their baseline status and affected criteria. An attributable failure is corrected and rechecked.

### Planned verification

- Compare the three authority-file hashes in each configuration and inspect the affected source references. Use the project's read-only memory health, ontology health and advanced-health commands to classify any pre-existing condition.
- Run .venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_repository_contract.py -k completion_guidance_reaches_template_and_active_root and .venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s Projects/Sys4AI-Template-Project/tests -p test_template_contract.py.
- Run .venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests. For a changed surface, compare against a before-change run on the same working baseline or its isolated equivalent. Attribute failures individually and keep unrelated repairs out of scope.
